It is a candidate shrine (ronsha) for Tabe Shrine in Kamo District, {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}, in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha register}}. Another theory identifies Tabe Shrine as {{ill|Tabekoten Shrine|ja|太部古天神社|qid=Q11444530}} in the same Kawabe town. Its {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former rank}} was village shrine.

It is about 800 m east of {{ill|Shinyamakawa Bridge|ja|新山川橋|qid=Q11502002}} over the {{ill|Hida River|fa|رود هیدا|fr|Hida-gawa|ja|飛騨川|no|Hida (elv)|ru|Хида (река)|th|แม่น้ำฮิดะ|uz|Hida daryosi|qid=Q3366160}}.

== Overview ==
The founding period is unknown. It was originally enshrined in a different location, but after being destroyed by fire it was relocated and rebuilt at the present site.
